description: Point clips at different media files (File > Link Media, Clip > Replace Footage) without the Link Media or Where Is the File dialogs: one clip to newPath, or every offline clip (or the items given) to the file of the same name found in searchFolders. Not undoable

depth.description: With searchFolders: how many folder levels to search. Default 5

item.description: With newPath: the clip to relink

name.description: Item name, when only one item has it

path.description: Bin path, "/"-separated, from the project root

items.description: With searchFolders: only these clips (still only the offline ones). Default: every offline clip in the project
A project item: its id (from list_project_items), its bin path such as "Footage/Interviews/a.mov", or its name when that is unique

name.description: Item name, when only one item has it

path.description: Bin path, "/"-separated, from the project root

newPath.description: Absolute path of the new media file for item

overrideChecks.description: Relink even when Premiere Pro finds the new file incompatible (different media type or duration). Default false

searchFolders.description: Relink offline clips to the file with the same name found in these folders (absolute paths)

name: relink_media
title: Relink Media
